save.text: Show tonight missing Sam; Scanlan voiced by Keyleth and Percy; Pike absent; Patrick Rothfuss joining via Skype.
Lootcrate is first sponsor; January theme 'Origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off at lootcrate.com/criticalrole.
Blue Microphones provided new audio equipment; bluemic.com mentioned by Matt.

Adventure recap: Vox Machina battled Chroma Conclave; defeated Thordak; fought Raishan who took Thordak's corpse and two eggs; Raishan located via scry on southern island (former Thordak lair / Opash's island); Kerrek (Patrick) joined and returned to Whitestone to help search.
Characters leveled: Scanlan, Percy, Pike all gained a level; players discussed Pike selecting an 8th-level cleric spell (cleric can prepare any cleric spells).

Magic items/loot noted: Dragonkilling sword (discussed/handed); Boots contested between Percy and Vex/Scanlan; Dwarven Thrower warhammer found—+3, thrown, returns, extra 1d8 (2d8 vs Giants), requires attunement by a dwarf.

Dwarven Thrower details: +3 warhammer requires dwarf attunement; returns when thrown (20/60 ft rules apply); damage is d8 (not d12). Travis (Grog) intends to attune and take it; Blood Axe to be given up.

Boots exchange/attunement notes: Boots of Elvenkind do NOT require attunement and will replace Pike's Sprinter's Boots (which do require attunement). Changing boots is not instantaneous in-play; Sprinter's Boots may grant important mobility.
Deathwalker's Ward: Percy (Liam) will attune it to necrotic damage.

Grog pulled cursed scimitar from Bag of Holding; upon contact it triggered a curse/vision (female with fanged teeth, snakes). Curse expended but left Grog permanently at -2 to all saving throws until a god removes it. (Matt confirmed).
Sword immediately rusted and became inert (gems cracked to dust) after curse triggered. (turns 177-178)

Party discussed remedies: Greater Restoration (5th-level) suggested by Pike; accepting help offers: Keyleth offered Ring of Protection +2 (attunement) to offset -2 to saves but Grog declined; Pike will attempt healing if needed.
Pike cast 5th-level Greater Restoration on Grog but headache remained; spell spent. (Matt, turn245)
Ring of Lightning Resistance card vanished (Keyleth noticed). (turn250)
Kerrek offered gear; party loaned Cloak of Displacement and a Ring of Invisibility to Kerrek; cloak can be worn over armor. (turns261-276,268-269)
Pike can cast Heroes' Feast (6th-level); party consumed it, gaining immunity to poison and fear and +15 max HP each; feast can feed up to 12 including Kerr, Allura, Kima, Trinket. (turns287-303,301)
Party holds a Gate Stone; Kima took it to give to Cassandra for safekeeping. (confirmed by Matt)
Kima and Allura arrived; they joined Heroes' Feast and are prepped for battle; Kima fully armored. (turns359,373,364)

Debate about transport: Vex/party considering scrying Opash's cave vs teleport/Transport Via Plants; scrying creates a visible magical sensor that creatures with invisibility-seeing can detect. Marisha prefers Transport Via Plants (lesser level than Teleport). Party leans toward immediate travel. (turns316-323,322,379)

Transport Via Plants used: Keyleth led party through Sun Tree portal to island near Opash's lab; Pass Without Trace cast before transit. Party emerged into jungle with radial tree blight centered on mountain/lab.
Kima tried Elven boots; initially reluctant but accepted after removing lower armor; boots noted to be quieter—Laura intends to give them to Kima but may wear if Kima declines.
Party observed trees blackened in a radial pattern from mountain; investigation revealed trees 'not alive' (Grog's -2 investigation commentary).

Transport Via Plants used: Keyleth led party through Sun Tree portal to island near Opash's lab; Pass Without Trace cast before transit. Party emerged into jungle with radial tree blight centered on mountain/lab. Trees are anciently dead/petrified (hundreds of years).

Party observed trees blackened in a radial pattern from mountain; investigation shows scarring not recent; no dragon tracks found; small animal tracks present. (Allura researched island: indigenous people disappeared after Opash settled; island considered cursed.)

Transport Via Plants used: Keyleth led party through Sun Tree to island near Opash's lab; Pass Without Trace cast. Party emerged into jungle with radial tree blight centered on mountain/lab. Trees anciently dead/petrified; ground shows increasing patches of unstable 'hollow earth' (sinkhole-like magical collapse) near mountain; patches form 10–15 ft ovals and grow denser toward mountain. (turns431,575-586)
Kima tried Elven boots; initially reluctant but accepted after removing lower armor; boots quieter—Laura intends to give them to Kima but may wear if Kima declines. (turn393)

Vax and Vex scouting: Vax nearly stepped into a different-texture oval patch; Vex spotted and warned him. Investigation rolls: Vex 26, Vax 18. Party avoids patches after identification; Grog tested a patch by throwing a rock which fell through—patches are unstable hollow-earth zones. (turns541-546,556-596)

Mountain entrance: ~200 ft from landing, large boulder (20–30 ft) jammed into cave mouth; holes in boulder consistent with huge dragon claws, some weathered—boulder has been placed/removed many times. Party spotted this by Perception/Investigation checks. (turns 620, 633, 640)

Trees/rock condition: Trees/jungle nearer mountain are rapidly dead in place (no blown debris direction); rock mostly normal except one section with different texture leading to boulder. Mountain ~600 ft tall, described as large rocky mound. (turns 603-606,620)

Transport Via Plants used: Keyleth led party through Sun Tree to island near Opash's lab; Pass Without Trace cast. Party emerged into jungle with radial tree blight centered on mountain/lab. Trees anciently dead/petrified; ground shows increasing patches of unstable 'hollow earth' (sinkhole-like magical collapse) near mountain; patches form 10–15 ft ovals and grow denser toward mountain. (turns431,575-586,431)

Vax and Vex scouting: Vax nearly stepped into a different-texture oval patch; Vex spotted and warned him. Investigation rolls: Vex 26, Vax 18. Party avoids patches after identification; Grog tested a patch by throwing a rock which fell through—patches are unstable hollow-earth zones. (turns541-546,556-596,545)

Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness: Patrick (Kerrek) used Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness and detected three dragon life-force sources roughly toward the mountain and below, within one mile. (turns679-692,671)

Keyleth used Stone Shape to create ~5-ft tunnel opening into mountain; opening allows arm reach and sight ~100 ft in where tunnel curves left and descends; Oracle Arrow showed dust-covered floor, no tracks, no light, no movement. (Perception/attack rolls: Keyleth failed perception 1; Laura's Oracle Arrow nat 20).

Party debating entry methods: risk of making noise (Raishan likely good hearing); options: stealth entry, Keyleth expend another 4th-level Stone Shape to enlarge, Grog physically break door (siege gauntlets available).

Transport Via Plants approach: party found fingerholds on boulder sealing lab entrance; considered using Oil of Etherealness (not enough for Percy; Scanlan or Pike could use); options discussed include using lever with Kima's sword, Grog brute force, or ethereal entry; investigation revealed dragon-sized fingerholds suggesting boulder jammed in place. (turns 431,823-892)
Oil of Etherealness present: Liam (Percy) has a flask but insufficient quantity to cover himself; Scanlan or Pike could be coated to become ethereal for ~1 hour to scout through rock. (turns 853-860)

Grog action options: party suggested Grog use leverage/assault; Grog prepared to try brute force; investigation showed possibility to fashion lever with multiple people; Grog has siege gauntlets (noise risk). (turns 852-876,870)

Transport Via Plants / lever plan succeeded: group used Pike+Grog leverage with Immovable Rods jammed into dragon foot-holes to wedge boulder ~1.5 ft open; rods holding slowly but boulder still slowly moving; party entered tunnel. Kerrek mentioned rod of immobility as brace. (turns 894-920,925)

Tunnel description & evidence: 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall carved tunnel with dust, rot, stagnant water smell, no airflow; floor peppered with small porous, often blackened/charred bone shards (indicative of burned remains). (turns 933,942-948)

Party stealth/investigation: characters made mixed rolls—some investigation (24 Scanlan noted materials), some low stealth requiring new stealth checks upon re-entering; no confirmed traps observed yet. (turns 936-941,953-957)

Tunnel description: 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall carved tunnel, mild descent, dust/rot/stagnant water smell, no airflow; floor has porous/blackened bone shards indicative of burned remains. Bones appear years old (layer of dust) — not ancient. (stealth checks noted).

Stealth checks: party re-rolled stealth; results: Travis 30, Laura 30, Liam 35, Taliesin 34, Marisha 30, Travis also 28->30, Laura Pike 25, Taliesin Scanlan 18, Patrick 29. (All rolled at turn965-975)
Pike cast Death Ward on Vex (4th-level spell) — effect lasts 8 hours; will prevent dropping to 0 HP once (turns 998-1000).

Tunnel description updated: tunnel has small alcoves/shelves every ~20 ft containing melted candles, skulls, small books, a wooden box (not trapped per checks), and a mummified raccoon-like creature; dim light dynamics: dagger flame gives ~60 ft vision for dagger-bearer, darkvision ~15 ft.
Pike previously cast Death Ward on Vex (4th-level) — effect lasts 8 hours; will prevent dropping to 0 HP once. (remains valid)

Recent stealth/visibility details: dagger flame now lit producing light; perception/investigation checks noted: Vax perception 29; investigation with disadvantage 18; Vax investigation 22 for box (not trapped); additional perception 22 revealed skulls/books/box; party continuing stealthy progress.
Tunnel alcoves confirmed contain two melted candles and a singular human skull on a shelf; skull bone appears slightly singed/darkened. (turns 1053,1147-1151,1149)
Kerrek (Patrick) used Divine Sense; detected an undead presence to the left, originating from wall area/shelf (not extremely powerful). (turns1102,1106,1109,1126)

Grog (Travis) moved to and retrieved the skull from the shelf and handed it to Kerrek; Kerrek considers the skull could be a watcher/spy; Kerrek lacks detailed recall (religion check ~12). (turns1138,1161-1162,1156-1159)

Tunnel alcoves confirmed contain two melted candles and a singular human skull on a shelf; skull bone appears slightly singed/darkened. Kerrek identified skull as source of undead energy with Divine Sense; skull not reacting while held. Kerrek stuffed skull in burlap sack and reoriented it toward wall. (turns1149,1164-1165,1190-1191)

Transport Via Plants / lever plan succeeded: group used Pike+Grog leverage with Immovable Rods jammed into dragon foot-holes to wedge boulder ~1.5 ft open; rods holding slowly but boulder still slowly moving; party entered tunnel. Kerrek mentioned rod of immobility as brace. (turns 894-920,925)

New chamber: hexagonal/‘vex’-shaped chamber ~25 ft high; central dark green marble pillar (~10 ft) topped by an imperfect iron bowl on a dais (~5–6 ft high). Off to right: large leather-bound tome and an unlit cold iron brazier with dried tinder. No undead detected within 60 ft by Divine Sense. (turns1199-1210,1226-1230)
Tunnel alcoves contain two melted candles and a singular human skull on a shelf; skull bone appears slightly singed/darkened. (observed more context: shelf near brazier/tome).
Central iron bowl on pillar contains long-dried dark burgundy residue—appears to be dried blood; scraping produced a powder with iron taste. (turns1261-1266,1282-1289)
Leather tome on shelf: large, plain cover/spine, thick leather—uncertain if tanned hide or flesh. Positioned near brazier and shelf. (turns1246,1297-1301)
Tunnel alcoves contain two melted candles and a slightly singed human skull on a shelf; skull was retrieved by Grog and handed to Kerrek. (turns 1053,1147-1162,1340-1342)
Grog retrieved the skull from the shelf and handed it to Kerrek; Kerrek considers it might be a watcher/spy; Kerrek's recall remains uncertain. (turns 1156-1162,1340-1342)

A weathered, old book on a shelf has text that shrinks and becomes unreadable as viewers approach or illuminate it; radiant light from Kerrek's hammer blanked the pages. Group plans to extinguish lights so someone with low-light vision can try reading. (turns 1327-1365,1367-1372)
Tunnel alcoves: two melted candles and a slightly singed human skull on a shelf; skull retrieved by Grog and handed to Kerrek. (turns 1053,1147-1162)
Kerrek (Patrick) used Divine Sense; detected an undead presence to the left, originating from wall area/shelf (not extremely powerful). (turns1102,1106,1109,1126)

Brazier/Book incident: Keyleth lit brazier causing explosive detonation; book destroyed. Kerrek and Keyleth failed saves and took 32 fire damage; others took 16 (rogue immune). Explosion smelled of extremely flammable liquids, not black powder. Party planning to pour monster blood into bowl to open door; have basilisk, black dragon, white dragon blood vials. (turns1397-1450)

Basilisk blood reacts to other blood: small drops sink into basilisk blood but alone didn't open door; placing blood caused door to begin opening and party took 1 point damage from lost blood. (turns1451-1470)

Four flaming, flame-wreathed floating skulls (likely undead, possibly from a bag) appeared from both ends of the hallway toward the party after door opened; Pike cast Holy Aura creating 30-ft radius protection with advantages/disadvantages as described. Initiative rolled. (turns1472-1490,1491-1509)
Tunnel alcoves: two melted candles and a slightly singed human skull on a shelf; skull retrieved by Grog and handed to Kerrek. (turns 1053,1147-1162)
Tunnel alcoves: two melted candles and a slightly singed human skull on a shelf; skull retrieved by Grog and handed to Kerrek. (turns1053,1147-1162,1162)

Brazier/Book incident: Keyleth lit brazier causing explosive detonation; book destroyed. Kerrek and Keyleth failed saves and took 32 fire damage; others took 16 (rogue immune). Explosion smelled of extremely flammable liquids, not black powder. Party planning to pour monster blood into bowl to open door; have basilisk, black dragon, white dragon blood vials. (turns1397-1450,1450)

Current combat: Skulls swarmed through lifted gate; four skulls (two per side). Scanlan turned invisible and backed to northern wall; Vax moved opposite and threw two daggers (19 and 10 damage). Keyleth cast Moonbeam (concentration) hitting two skulls for 13 radiant each; one damaged skull nearly fell. Initiative order placed Scanlan and Vax to act first; Pike at end of round; Kerrek rolled a 1 for initiative. (turns1516-1589,1516)

Four flame skulls fired synchronized fireballs (four lines) hitting party; Dexterity saves with advantage for most; Scanlan exempt. Evasion applied for Vax. Damage varied: multiple characters took significant fire damage (Grog ~48, Percy 56, Keyleth saved all -> at 50 HP, Vex at 57 HP, Pike 44 after resistance). (turns1595-1680)
Flame skulls moved to wall, ended turn; party in a 'kill box'. (turn1683)
Percival (Scanlan/Travis?) killed two flame skulls with Animus gun shots (sharpshooter, deadeye used; regained grit points). (turns1692-1718)
Kerrek's Aura of Divinity (Charisma bonus) grants +3 to saving throws for allies close to him; would have affected several saves (Pike, Grog calculations discussed). (turns1722-1732,1736-1742)
